conclusion.text: AUREKA AS is an active private limited company in construction, based in Sokndal. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) it reported revenue of NOK 5 144 207 and a profit of NOK 2 234 840, with positive equity of NOK 27 737 054. It has a registered CEO, board chair and auditor, and its 2025 accounts were audited. The most recent dated item found is "Revisor" (category: Auditor), published 2026-10-10 (Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer). summary: AUREKA AS (org. no. 931 198 157) is a private limited company (AS) based in Sokndal, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2023-04-14. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 43.221 (Rørleggerarbeid). In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 5 144 207 and net income was NOK 2 234 840. Group (consolidated) revenue was NOK 97 635 394 (group accounts, period 2023-01-01/2023-12-31). CEO: Christer Volden; board chair: Kjell Inge Mæland; auditor: REVISJON VEST AS. Most recent dated item found (2026-10-10): "Revisor" (category: Auditor) – Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer. 9 dated news/announcement items are listed with source links.

In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) it reported revenue of NOK 36 996 and a profit of NOK 1 677 605, with positive equity of NOK 21 789 854.
It has a registered board chair, and its 2025 accounts were audited.
The most recent dated item found is "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts), published 2026-05-16 (Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer).
No risk flags were found in the registers checked (bankruptcy, liquidation, compulsory dissolution, negative equity, losses).

conclusion.method: Each claim is built only from the listed facts; nothing is inferred beyond them.

summary: APAXCON AS (org. no. 912 992 969) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bærum, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2013-12-23. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 64.323 (Andre egeninvesteringsselskaper). In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 36 996 and net income was NOK 1 677 605. Board chair: Fred Alveberg. Most recent dated item found (2026-05-16): "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts) – Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer. 15 dated news/announcement items are listed with source links.
